title: Add KMS scope-hints and audit-integrity gateway for region-aware installs
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: Private installs sometimes allocate customer CMKs without sufficient service-context hints which increased manual reconciliation work and produced noisy audit trails when region pinning diverged. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) a KMS scope-hint propagation mechanism that narrows candidate key pools at install time based on operator/service attributes (region, tenancy, service-account tags), and 2) an audit-integrity gateway which computes a compact deterministic hash for each KMS usage event and forwards a signed envelope to the central audit collector. Goals: reduce key blast radius, make KMS selection deterministic for repeatable installs, and provide a compact integrity proof for compliance reviewers. Changes are backwards-compatible; installer defaults to opt-in via a feature flag and we provide a migration utility for existing clusters. See the rollout and rollback plan below. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-2310) - [x] Installer flag and config defaults - [x] Migration tool to generate scope-hint manifests for existing installs - [x] Audit envelope signer and verification test harness - [x] End-to-end test in staging with a seeded multi-region cluster - [x] Documentation and upgrade notes (docs/region-keying.md) Rollout plan: 1) Enable feature flag in staging for 2 weeks and collect telemetry, 2) run migration tool for opt-in customers, 3) enable by default on next minor release. Backout: disable feature flag and run revert-migration script to remove added scope-hint CRs. Related: SUP-9021 (support case showing two installs with mismatched KMS allocation), ENG-2311 (follow-up to add operator-scoped key templates). Note: the audit-integrity gateway emits only hashes and signatures; it does not include plaintext key material or customer payloads. Configuration examples and operator migration steps are appended in docs and the installer README.

chore(migrations): add generate-scope-hint tool with dry-run mode
feat(audit): add audit-integrity-gateway binary and signing key rotation logic
test(e2e): add kms-scope-hints e2e scenario for 3-region cluster
review_comments: Diego: Can we avoid introducing a new dependency for crypto? Prefer using the existing signing helper in audit/common. (addressed)
Anya: Please add a unit test that validates deterministic key selection when region and service-account tag are inverted. (added test)
Samir: Are there any latency concerns when the gateway signs every KMS event? Probed impact and added a batching path for high-throughput paths to mitigate — see signing.go comments.
Priya (author): Reply: batching path is disabled by default and gated by an operator flag; we measured 3-5ms median additional latency in staging. Full numbers in the CI artifact.
Security (automated): flagged potential entropy source for signing; author fixed to use KMS-backed randomness or OS CSPRNG depending on install profile.
merge_outcome: merged via squash-merge. Commit message sanitized and changelog entry added.
release_notes: Add optional KMS scope-hints to narrow key selection during private installs; introduce audit-integrity gateway that emits signed hashes for KMS usage events. Feature is opt-in and behind installer feature flag. Migration helper included.
